scores.justification: The simulation captures authentic Czech institutional and expert voices with strong linguistic realism, avoids hallucinating specific laws, but offers only moderately actionable editorial critique while maintaining good ideological variance between industry, ministry, and expert perspectives.

Czech posts sound authentic with natural phrasing, no factual hallucinations detected, comments provide specific actionable triggers (e.g., 30-40% funding on legal, 15-20% competitive loss), and agents span distinct ideological positions from privacy advocacy to investor pragmatism.

The posts and comments use authentic Czech phrasing and football-specific jargon, but the swarm collapses into a repetitive demand for VAR audio release with only a single token counter-argument, lacking actionable journalistic triggers or ideological diversity.

Agenti často sklouzávají do angličtiny nebo nepřirozené 'přeložené' češtiny, chybí jim autentický jazykový naturel, a přestože nehalucinují fakta, jejich perspektivy se slévají do dvou generických táborů bez hlubších redakčně využitelných insightů.
Posts show decent Czech emotional range but comments collapse into repetitive, sanitized PR-speak, lacking the raw, specific triggers a journalist needs.
The Czech posts show some local flavor but the comments devolve into generic, non-Czech diplomatic statements, reducing overall realism and actionable insight.

The posts and comments capture authentic Czech football debate rhetoric and frustration, but the swarm homogenizes around a single 'transparency vs. defense of authority' axis with repetitive phrasing and lacks specific, actionable journalistic leads.

Agenti používají uvěřitelnou českou politickou rétoriku, ale obsahově se točí v kruhu opakujících se frází o 'rodinných rozpočtech' a 'preventivních programech', aniž by přinášeli novinářsky využitelné slepé skvrny nebo výrazně odlišné ideologické perspektivy.

Czech posts show decent local nuance but comments drift toward generic EU-speak; no hallucinations detected; critiques identify blind spots but lack specific textual triggers; ideological variance exists but converges on similar pro-regulation stances.

The simulation uses realistic Czech bureaucratic phrasing but lacks authentic fan vulgarity and specific local references, while all agents orbit the same 'transparency vs. procedure' axis without offering truly distinct ideological angles or actionable journalistic leads.

The Czech phrasing and rhetorical style are authentic, but the swarm collapses into a repetitive echo chamber fixated on the same '38% mortality' statistic and 'hybrid model' demand, offering little actionable journalistic insight beyond the initial post.
